Mrs. Mary Jacobs - Elderly lady - Stroke some years ago - whole right side numb .....
Dr. Richard Mason - 63 - Episcop. - hard of hearing and poor sight . ...
Peggie Jane Wortley - 7 - Strept-pneumonia - not much hope - father (Episcopelian) non Cath.
Jean Dunbar - 13 - presbiterian, spascic-paralysis - has not walked for 3 yrs. Entered in Ser. Masses To-day - parents taking Vol. I City of God.
Michael Jagielo - 56 - Cancer under arm - now for three yrs. Mary Murray - 11 - Epiletic fits - abcesses in ear
